lines: Cem Garih Nahmiyas, Investor Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 86,129 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹1.30 crore are scheduled to arrive on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer timetable.
Gain of ₹0.18 crore before offer expenses and taxes; retained shares lock in for 6 months from allotment, so more value may follow.
Caveat: the pre-offer holding and allotment date are not confirmed from the documents.
